summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching Hong Kong Exchange next-day disclosure returns for May 20–June 3, 2026. The issuer repurchased a series of American depositary shares (each representing one Class A ordinary share) at prices ranging from USD 22.12 to USD 22.86 per ADS. No board recommendation or financial advisor is noted. The repurchases are open-market buybacks under the issuer's existing program, with shares held as treasury and not yet cancelled. This is a capital-return event returning cash to shareholders. Watch for continuation of the buyback program and potential impact on liquidity.
